The issuer shows decent balance-sheet strength with equity of 773M versus total liabilities of 1,148M (equity covers ~40% of assets) and reasonable near-term liquidity (current ratio ≈ 1.5). However, profitability is only moderate (net margin ~4% and EBIT margin ~7%), which limits the cushion for a downturn. Overall, this profile aligns best with the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
